svg.title: Chan2007 chip wall preparation
svg.desc: Original text-and-arrow summary: piranha-clean the assembled device at room temperature, retaining the buried SU-8 bond, then silanize oxide walls with FDTS solution before chip exchange. Not a device cross-section or measured coating geometry.

g.text: Device treatment · separate from reagent feeds
Keep SU-8 between the bonded wafers.
FDTS is not a nanoparticle reaction feed.
Solution recipe, time and temperature unreported.
Required for the source's on-chip branches.
Authored process summary; no device geometry inferred.
Chan et al. · Main p.3; SI pp.1,3 · Figure S1(c)
